strings:
A live stream page built from ordinary HTML, for Noctiluca's tests and
     tape: a playing video, the channel's name, avatar and title, a
     role=log panel beside it that this page's own script fills on a timer,
     and an input that sends (the page echoes the message). Local: no
     network, no third-party assets. ?quiet stops the timer.
